question: What residual moisture did the NMP- and the water-processed NMC532 cathodes contain at 20 °C?
rendered: According to the text, at 20 °C, the NMP-processed NMC 532 cathode contained 200 ppm of residual moisture, while the water-processed NMC 532 cathode contained 625 ppm of residual moisture.
